design_philosophy: Terminal/Hacker variant. High-contrast, aggressive, performance-focused. Pure black background with electric green accents. No soft edges or friendly pastels. Deep technical aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use a 2-column layout for desktop (md:grid-cols-2). Left side for branding/story, Right side for the interactive purchase terminal.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm to maintain sharp, technical feel.

visual_effects.background_effects: Use a subtle radial gradient behind the main section: `bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top_left,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[#00FF00]/10 via-[#050505] to-[#050505]`
visual_effects.borders: 1px solid borders everywhere. `border-zinc-800` normally, `border-[#00FF00]` when active or focused.

Header.layout: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-md bg-black/80, border-b border-zinc-800, flex justify-between items-center py-4
Header.logo: Text logo 'GrimAIO' in JetBrains Mono, text-[#00FF00]
Header.actions: Cart trigger button with item count badge (neon green background, black text)

Hero_Section.left_column: Contains the title 'GrimAIO', a technical subtitle ('UNDETECTED. UNMATCHED.'), and the 'Join Discord' button. The Discord button should be stylized with a subtle green border or traditional Discord blue, using href 'https://discord.gg/t2VrGXbTV'.
Hero_Section.right_column: The Purchase Terminal. Contains the Product Selection, Quantity Selector, and Checkout actions.

Product_Selection.styling: Unselected: `bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-400`. Selected: `bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#00FF00] text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,0,0.15)]`

Quantity_Selector.layout: Flex row, items center, border border-zinc-800 w-fit
Quantity_Selector.buttons: Square buttons, w-10 h-10, hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors, font-mono

Action_Buttons.add_to_cart: Full width, `bg-[#00FF00] text-black hover:bg-[#00cc00]` transition-all, font-mono, bold. `data-testid='add-to-cart-btn'`
Action_Buttons.stripe_checkout: Full width, `bg-[#635BFF] text-white hover:bg-[#5851E5]` (Stripe brand color) or stark white `bg-white text-black`. `data-testid='checkout-btn'`

Cart_Sheet.content: List of cart items, total price calculation, and a final Checkout button.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over pure black has sufficient contrast. Use text-zinc-400 for secondary, never darker.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have the specified `data-testid` attributes.

media_and_assets.instruction: Do NOT use any placeholder image URLs. Rely entirely on CSS gradients, typography, and SVG icons (Lucide) to create the dark hacker aesthetic. Images are not needed for this terminal-style interface.
